raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "be the head of community"
      role subject ?p
      role object "Dojo Gaming Hub din Str. Avram Iancu nr. 3"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "organize"
      role subject "Dojo Gaming Hub din Str. Avram Iancu nr. 3"
      role object "the League of Legends tournaments"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
